profile.Name: Reva
profile.Job: Swordswoman trained by the Flotsam Ninjas
profile.Personality: Honorable, angry, and godless. She despises faith in Okran, swears to serve no man again, and loves nothing more than striking at the Holy Nation.
profile.Backstory: She escaped the Holy Nation by her own grit, leaving many of her sisters behind. The Flotsam Ninjas trained her as an apprentice, but her anger kept her from finishing, and she now wants to leave Flotsam Village.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Sharp and scornful whenever Okran or the Holy Nation comes up. She calls women "sister".
